rule_text.name: 702.255a
rule_text.rule: Monument is an ability found on the front face of some transforming double-faced cards (see rule 712, “Double-Faced Cards”). “Monument [cost]” means “You may cast this card transformed from your graveyard by paying [cost] rather than its mana cost. If this spell would leave the stack other than being put onto the battlefield, or the permanent it becomes would leave the battlefield, exile it instead.” See rule 712.4b.

rule_text.name: 702.255b
rule_text.rule: A resolving transforming double-faced spell that was cast using its monument ability enters the battlefield with its back face up.
